title: Unbelievably Crisp Russian Beef Muffins
description: A charred and crisp Russian dish perfect for a date night, featuring muffins and a rich deglaze, all while being low-fat-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, chopped onion, sliced mushrooms, flour, eggs, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Divide the mixture into 6 equal parts and shape each part into a muffin.
Place the muffins on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush the tops with olive oil.
Bake the muffins in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
While the muffins are baking, heat the beef broth and tomato paste in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly.
After the muffins have baked for 20 minutes, remove them from the oven and brush the tops with the beef broth and tomato paste mixture.
Return the muffins to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the tops are charred and crisp.
Remove the muffins from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
